name: Claude Code plugin and hooks for docs
description:
generate-plugin for docs: skill teaching lookup and the condense/prune workflow.
Hooks: on Read/Edit push matching entries per kind push policy (summary, full body under ~150 tokens, counts as read); on Stop run docs affected.
author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>

comments.author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>
comments.text: Requirement from the user: the docs skill must strongly discourage editing .repo-docs/*.yaml directly (Edit/Write or shell). Agents always go through the docs CLI (add/edit/rm from #40, check --fix, etc.); if the CLI can't make the change, tell the user instead. Only exception: resolving a git merge conflict, followed by docs check. Mirror the wording of the issues skill (RepoIssuesCli/Cli/Plugin/IssuesPlugin.cs). Note #34 should come after #40 so the skill can point at real edit commands.

comments.author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>
comments.text: Merged 315a3cf. plugins/docs: a skill with the bold no-direct-edit rule, lookup/write/affected/condense workflows, a kinds table, and the command and exit-code tables. hooks/hooks.json: SessionStart (record HEAD), PostToolUse Read and Edit|Write|MultiEdit (push per kind policy; bodies <= 600 chars in full, marked read; max 10 per push; no re-push within a session), Stop (block once with the affected addresses since the session's starting HEAD; silent when stop_hook_active). docs hook <event> always exits 0 and swallows errors. The session cache lives in .repo-docs/.session/ with its own .gitignore. PluginDefinition gained Files for extra plugin files. CI and pack-install now pack and publish both tools. Follow-ups: hooks need docs on PATH (otherwise Claude Code shows a non-blocking hook error); full-body pushes write read dates into the YAML mid-session; PreToolUse would push on-edit rules before the edit, once additionalContext is documented there.
